{"text":"A Passage to Paradis

A strange vessel waits along the coast.

Find the dock in the Overworld:

X: -713
Z: -180

The deck is at Y: 64."}

{"text":"Beyond the Dock

Walk south along the dock and step onto its portal to enter Paradis.

Titans await beyond. Prepare before crossing!

Use a return portal in Paradis to come home."}
